title: Don't mark X86_DRAM (and similar DRAM-backed x86 regions) as volatile
description: ApplyPspAddressSpaces.java currently sets volatile=true on every block in the X86 overlay (DRAM + MMIO + SAM). Volatile is correct for MMIO and SAM (POST status, UART, PCI cfg, USB PHY FW), but X86_DRAM is plain DRAM and should be non-volatile so the decompiler can treat repeated loads as cacheable/optimizable. Fix: per-region volatile flag, defaulting to true for MMIO/SAM and false for X86_DRAM.
